name: x
description: A rounded x symbol with unboxed and framed styles.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: Owner requested Plus/Minus/X to follow the frame family with three explicit styles: Outline Regular1.75, unboxed Bold2.50, and Filled. Frame None Filled equals the unboxed Bold2.50 expansion, as Menu/Search. Square/Circle Filled uses a solid upright frame and the exact Regular1.75 glyph cutout. Use shared centerlines centered at12,12, extent4.5 on both axes; Plus and X retain identical optical bounds10.75 square at Regular and11.50 at Bold; Minus shares their horizontal extent. Smaller source glyphs reserve actual Circle clearance at every weight without independent per-frame scaling. Frame exteriors span2..22, Square radius6 and Circle radius10, same as Arrow/Chevron. Outline centerlines are2.875..21.125 with corner radius5.125, circle9.125. Bold is explicitly unboxed; selecting it ignores a frame. At Bold the Circle border clears the X by at least.261px. Filled standalone is the exact union of the shared centerlines expanded at2.50; frame holes use1.75. This supersedes the previous standalone boxed Plus/X Filled semantics. Morph timing remains approved, while its boxed endpoints derive from the new Square frame sources. Family extension adds Minus only; it is not a six unrelated-icon batch. All three revised identities await owner review. Current Square rounding trial: owner requested rounder enclosing frames. The exterior radius is now6 at unchanged bounds2..22; the matching Regular1.75 Outline centerline uses radius5.125 at bounds2.875..21.125. Only the outer enclosing contour changed. Inner glyph coordinates, cutout contours, object-specific rounding and positions remain exact. This rounding trial awaits owner visual review.

review.note: Owner-requested rounder Square exterior radius6 trial; inner glyph preserved. Awaiting visual review.
